description_expanded: Coral Rose is a three bedroom vacation rental on Scenic 30A in Seacrest Beach. This iconic, three story A Frame beach home has two open decks on the second and third floors where you may enjoy the sea breeze while listening to the distant sound of the surf. These beach facing balconies also afford views of the emerald hued gulf waters. Although the beach is just a stroll away you may want to just hang out at the house and enjoy the refreshing private swimming pool in the fenced yard. The tiled deck that surrounds the pool comes with chaise lounge chairs that beckon you to relax. Inside, the main living area on the second floor has full access to the wide covered balcony where you may enjoy visiting with family. The kitchen is decorated in nautical colors with white cabinetry and navy blue counter tops. One of the counters serves as a pass through bar with four stools where guests may enjoy some fresh steamed shrimp. White tiled flooring sweeps through the comfortably furnished family room that faces a wall with two sunny windows and a sliding glass door that goes out onto the covered deck. A rectangular dining table beneath a vintage chandelier sits nearby and easily can accommodate six. A spacious Guest Suite on this same level has two queens and one full sized bed. The full hall bathroom serves this bedroom and doubles as a convenient Powder Room. Upstairs you will find the Master Bedroom Suite that has is nicely decorated with a king sized bed, a wide screen TV on the long white dresser and private access to the open air sun deck with views of the gleaming gulf in the distance. A private ensuite bath includes a walk-in shower. Another Guest Suite on this third floor level also has a king sized bed and utilizes a full hall bath with a walk-in shower. Front and center on South Walton's famed Scenic 30A, Coral Rose is only minutes from everything Seacrest Beach has to offer. Explore delectable dining options, mom & pop shops, and funky art galleries. Head a little further and discover the neighboring communities of Seagrove and Seaside to the west and Alys and Rosemary Beach to east. Get away from it all or surround yourself with excitement when you spend your next South Walton vacation at Coral Rose. First Floor: Covered Parking Second Floor: Living Room with Balcony Access, Kitchen, Bedroom with Two Queens and One Full Bed, Hall Bath with Tub/Shower Combo and Laundry. Third Floor: King Master Bedroom with Walk-In Shower and Balcony Access, King Bedroom, Hall Bath with Walk-In Shower. *Live TV is not provided. Roku Streaming Services are available.
